---
title: "Overview of winter {{type}} in {{this_location_name}}"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(effectclass)
library(git2rdata)
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
root <- "../../../data"
locgroup <- tolower("{{this_location_code}}")
threshold <- log(0.75)
type <- "{{type}}" == "average"
```

```{r}
#| label: prepare-data
read_vc("species", root = root) |>
  select(-"gbif") |>
  mutate(
    scientific = tolower(.data$scientific) |>
      gsub(pattern = " ", replacement = "-") |>
      sprintf(fmt = "[%2$s](../%1$s.html)", .data$scientific)
  ) -> speciesname
read_vc("analysis", root = root) |>
  filter(
    str_detect(.data$model_type, "yearly imputed index"),
    str_detect(.data$model_type, "Month") == type
  ) |>
  transmute(.data$analysis, .data$species, .data$model_type ) -> analysis
file.path(root, locgroup) |>
  list.files(pattern = "average.csv", recursive = TRUE) |>
  map(~read_vc(.x, root = file.path(root, locgroup))) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  group_by(.data$analysis, .data$duration) |>
  slice_max(.data$centre_winter, n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(
    .data$analysis, .data$duration, .data$estimate,
    ci = format_ci(
      .data$estimate, lcl = .data$lcl, ucl = .data$ucl, link = "log"
    ),
    last_winter = .data$centre_winter + (.data$duration - 1) / 2,
  ) |>
  bind_rows(
    file.path(root, locgroup) |>
      list.files(pattern = "total.csv", recursive = TRUE) |>
      map(~read_vc(.x, root = file.path(root, locgroup))) |>
      bind_rows() |>
      filter(!is.na(.data$estimate)) |>
      group_by(.data$analysis) |>
      slice_max(.data$winter, n = 1) |>
      ungroup() |>
      transmute(
        .data$analysis, duration = 1, .data$estimate,
        ci = format_ci(
          .data$estimate, lcl = .data$lcl, ucl = .data$ucl, link = "log"
        ),
        last_winter = .data$winter
      )
  ) |>
  inner_join(analysis, by = "analysis") |>
  mutate(
    species = as.integer(.data$species),
    period = ifelse(
      .data$duration > 1, .data$duration,
      grepl("smoothed", .data$model_type) + 1
    ) |>
      factor(
        levels = c(10, 5, 2, 1),
        labels = c(
          "10 winter average", "5 winter average", "smoother", "winter estimate"
        )
      )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(.data$period)) |>
  select(-"model_type", -"duration", -"analysis") |>
  inner_join(speciesname, by = c("species" = "euring")) |>
  select(-"species", species = "scientific") -> estimates
file.path(root, locgroup) |>
  list.files(pattern = "trend.csv", recursive = TRUE) |>
  map(~read_vc(.x, root = file.path(root, locgroup))) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  group_by(.data$analysis, .data$duration) |>
  slice_max(.data$centre_winter, n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(.data$duration) |>
  filter(.data$centre_winter == max(.data$centre_winter)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(
    .data$analysis, .data$centre_winter, .data$duration, .data$estimate,
    classification = classification(
      .data$duration * .data$lcl, .data$duration * .data$ucl,
      threshold = threshold
    ),
    ci = format_ci(
      .data$estimate, lcl = .data$lcl, ucl = .data$ucl, link = "log",
      percent = TRUE, change = TRUE
    ) |>
      paste(.data$classification),
    ci_total = format_ci(
      .data$duration * .data$estimate, lcl = .data$duration * .data$lcl,
      ucl = .data$duration * .data$ucl, link = "log", percent = TRUE,
      change = TRUE
    ) |>
      paste(.data$classification)
  ) |>
  inner_join(analysis, by = "analysis") |>
  select(-"analysis", -"model_type") |>
  mutate(species = as.integer(.data$species)) |>
  inner_join(speciesname, by = c("species" = "euring")) |>
  select(-"species", species = "scientific") -> trends
file.path(root, locgroup) |>
  list.files(pattern = "difference.csv", recursive = TRUE) |>
  map(~read_vc(.x, root = file.path(root, locgroup))) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  filter(.data$duration %in% c(1, 10)) |>
  group_by(.data$analysis, .data$duration, .data$centre_start) |>
  slice_max(.data$centre_end, n = 1) |>
  group_by(.data$duration) |>
  filter(.data$centre_end == max(.data$centre_end)) |>
  group_by(.data$analysis, .data$duration) |>
  slice_max(.data$centre_start, n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(
    .data$analysis, .data$centre_start, .data$centre_end, .data$duration,
    .data$estimate,
    classification = classification(.data$lcl, .data$ucl, threshold),
    ci = format_ci(
      .data$estimate, lcl = .data$lcl, ucl = .data$ucl, link = "log",
      percent = TRUE, change = TRUE
    ) |>
      paste(.data$classification)
  ) |>
  inner_join(analysis, by = "analysis") |>
  select(-"analysis", -"model_type") |>
  mutate(species = as.integer(.data$species)) |>
  inner_join(speciesname, by = c("species" = "euring")) |>
  select(-"species", species = "scientific") -> differences
```

## Average number over a period

```{r}
#| label: tbl-average-last
#| tbl-cap: "winter {{type}} for the most recent period per species in
#|   {{this_location_name}}.
#|   The latest winter refers to the latest winter in which the species
#|   was present in the region.
#|   The numbers between the brackets indicate the 90% credible interval
#|   around the estimated average.
#|   We rounded the estimate to a magnitude depending on the uncertainty of
#|   the estimate."
estimates |>
  filter(.data$period == "10 winter average") |>
  arrange(.data$estimate) |>
  pull(.data$species) -> species_order
estimates |>
  select("species", `latest winter` = "last_winter", "period", "ci") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "period", values_from = "ci", names_sort = TRUE) |>
  mutate(species = factor(.data$species, levels = rev(species_order))) |>
  arrange(.data$species) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_markdown(columns = "species") |>
  cols_align(
    columns = -"species",
    align = "center"
  ) |>
  opt_interactive(
    use_search = TRUE, use_pagination = FALSE, use_resizers = TRUE,
    use_highlight = TRUE, use_compact_mode = TRUE
  )
```

# Linear trends

```{r}
#| label: tbl-average-trend-short
#| tbl-cap: "Short term linear trend in winter {{type}} per species still
#|   present in {{this_location_name}}.
#|   Expressed as a yearly percentage change."
trends |>
  filter(.data$duration %in% c(10, 12)) |>
  group_by(.data$species) |>
  slice_max(.data$duration, n = 1) |>
  arrange(.data$classification, desc(.data$estimate)) |>
  pull(.data$species) -> species_order
trends |>
  filter(.data$duration %in% c(10, 12)) |>
  transmute(
    period = paste(
      .data$centre_winter - (.data$duration - 1) / 2,
      .data$centre_winter + (.data$duration - 1) / 2, sep = "-"
    ),
    .data$species, .data$ci, .data$classification
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "period", values_from = c("ci", "classification")) |>
  rename_with(~gsub("ci_", "", .x)) |>
  mutate(species = factor(.data$species, levels = species_order)) |>
  arrange(.data$species) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_markdown(columns = "species") |>
  cols_align(
    columns = -"species",
    align = "center"
  ) |>
  opt_interactive(
    use_search = TRUE, use_pagination = FALSE, use_resizers = TRUE,
    use_highlight = TRUE, use_compact_mode = TRUE
  ) |>
  data_color(
    columns = starts_with("classification"), direction = "column",
    target_columns = 2:3,
    palette = effectclass:::detailed_signed_palette
  ) |>
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("classification"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-average-trend-long

  ) |>
  arrange(.data$species) |>

  ) |>
  cols_hide(columns = "classification")
```

# Difference between two periods

```{r}
#| label: tbl-average-difference
#| tbl-cap: "Difference between two periods in winter {{type}} per species
#|   still present in {{this_location_name}}."
differences |>
  group_by(.data$species) |>
  slice_max(.data$duration, n = 1) |>
  arrange(.data$classification, desc(.data$estimate)) |>
  pull(.data$species) -> species_order
differences |>
  transmute(
    period = ifelse(
      .data$duration == 1,
      sprintf("%.0f vs %.0f", .data$centre_end, .data$centre_start),
      sprintf(
        "%i-%i vs %i-%i",
        .data$centre_end - (.data$duration - 1) / 2,
        .data$centre_end + (.data$duration - 1) / 2,
        .data$centre_start - (.data$duration - 1) / 2,
        .data$centre_start + (.data$duration - 1) / 2
      )
    ),
    .data$species, .data$ci, .data$classification
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "period", values_from = c("ci", "classification")
  ) |>
  rename_with(~gsub("ci_", "", .x)) |>
  mutate(species = factor(.data$species, levels = species_order)) |>
  arrange(.data$species) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_markdown(columns = "species") |>
  cols_align(
    columns = -"species",
    align = "center"
  ) |>
  opt_interactive(
    use_search = TRUE, use_pagination = FALSE, use_resizers = TRUE,
    use_highlight = TRUE, use_compact_mode = TRUE
  ) |>
  data_color(
    columns = starts_with("classification"), direction = "column",
    target_columns = 2:3,
    palette = effectclass:::detailed_signed_palette
  ) |>
  cols_hide(columns = starts_with("classification"))
```
